purpose: Challenge the selected same-fiscal-quarter announcement-delay improvement rank against the complete 101-definition terminal library before any Campaign070 source row or value is read.

selected_mechanism.name: quarterly_announcement_delay_improvement_yoy_rank_1y
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A positive same-quarter year-over-year filing-delay improvement represents lower issuer-specific reporting friction that may remain under-reflected over three sessions.
selected_mechanism.formula: Average-tie percentile rank of prior-year same-quarter announcement delay minus current announcement delay, after exact event matching and strict-next-session activation.

overlap_challenges.reason: Freshness is stock-day age since the latest disclosure and timeliness is current raw delay. Campaign070 removes issuer-specific same-quarter prior-year delay and ranks only the improvement transition. Equal current delay can have different improvements and vice versa.

Campaign052 measures dispersion across four consecutive report delays and is invariant to their order. Campaign070 uses exactly one current/prior-year same-quarter signed difference and preserves whether delay shortened.
Peer crowding depends on how many issuers share the exact announcement date. Campaign070 ignores peer counts and compares only the issuer's own matched fiscal-quarter delay transition.
Campaign070 projects no ROE, profit, revenue, net-profit, growth, change, or acceleration field; disclosure dates determine both availability and the score itself.
Campaign070 reads only stock-day identity and three quarterly identity/date fields. It cannot reproduce a minute path, market, activity, price, volume, amount, or VWAP mechanism.
Candidate49 remains the only prospective candidate and uses future minute close/volume/amount. Campaign070 is historical-only disclosure-timing research with no Candidate49 backfill.
Campaign063 remains in the complete library despite zero eligible values. Its cross-sectional minute-return state mechanism is definitionally disjoint from issuer disclosure-delay improvement.

Only exact prior-year same-quarter delay improvement, one strict-next-session activation, and one average-tie cross-sectional rank are allowed. No inverse, alternate lag, raw scale, bucket, sign, threshold, subset, year, regime, weight, or model is selected.

counterfactual_checks.meaning: The score is a transition, not a current delay level.
Issuer-specific level effects are differenced out before ranking.
The factor is not a peer-count re-expression.
The score reads no financial value or minute field.

design_choices_frozen_before_values.availability: first accepted session strictly after current announcement_date

decision.next_action: Freeze the exact coverage-first no-return protocol, comparator source split, one-trial catalog, implementation, and tests before reading any Campaign070 source row or value.
